season.evidence: Web search (Mountaineers, SummitPost Raven Ridge, Lemke, climberkyle): Raven Ridge feasible May-Oct, late Sep/early Oct best for larches; logged traverse ascents are mostly Sep-Oct. Stored Jun-Oct kept.

track.why: Logged route is Raven Ridge-Hoodoo Peak Traverse (16 Oct 2022, Successful Summit). Report climbs the right gully to Raven Ridge, crosses Libby Peak, the knife-edge class 4 and the 5.7 overhang to Hoodoo, matching our overview; track starts and ends at the Libby Lake trailhead (4 m loop) and passes within 19 m of our Hoodoo summit pin. Mid October is within the window.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Sep 2018 multi-peak Bulger day, no usable track for this route; described the same ridge in the other direction, used only for a fact.
3 Oct 2026, report says it went straight at the summit via the south ridge, not the traverse.

pins.name: Libby Lake Trailhead
pins.evidence: Route stores no Trailhead pin (trailheadName only). Recording 2060092 starts and ends at 48.27605,-120.29005 (logged as Libby Lake TH, 4421 ft); the hike page for the Libby Lake trail (#415) lists its trailhead at 48.2759, -120.2900, within ~20 m of the recording start.

facts.text: In the Raven Ridge gully the line right of centre is steeper, crumbly class 3-4; veering left about two-thirds of the way up finds easier ground.

Split the long day with a camp near the old cabin about five miles up the Libby Lake trail; a rope for simul-climbing the knife-edge works, and a sling is left at the 5.7 overhang for parties going the other way.
By mid-October the larches are past peak with needles dropping, and mornings start freezing.
In mid-September a rappel anchor was in place at the exposed class 4 section north of Libby Peak, though it was not needed in dry conditions.

notes: Standard Scramble on this peak already has tracks and is not in this packet. Direction Raven Ridge to Hoodoo matches the stored pro tip.
